INSIDE DEVIN — BRAIN2PRINT THIRD-PARTY NOTICES

==============================================================================

Generated by processing/generate_brain2print_notices.py from installed production dependencies.
This inventory intentionally includes transitive production packages that a browser build may tree-shake. Root development dependencies are not traversed; transitive runtime packages may include build helpers.
This fork uses the ITK-Wasm quality meshing path; the niimath package is not included in these runtime roots.

==============================================================================

UPSTREAM
Brain2Print: https://github.com/niivue/brain2print
Pinned commit: efd4adaca25f07384bb088de27f93bc6528cd999
https://github.com/niivue/brain2print/tree/efd4adaca25f07384bb088de27f93bc6528cd999

==============================================================================

MODIFICATIONS
This independent educational adaptation adds an Inside Devin interface and scroll presentation; fixes the source to Devin’s publicly shared MRI and local asset paths; removes NIfTI export controls; supports cached Brain2Print results, error handling, and cancellation; and selects the upstream ITK-Wasm quality meshing route. The BrainChop inference worker, model weights, and tensor operations remain upstream. Interface code and build configuration have been adapted. This is not an endorsement by the upstream authors.
